style: Match the attached reference's glossy warm golden-yellow hand-painted 2D mascot illustration EXACTLY. Not pixel art. Full body entirely visible.

calm.action: Continuous subtle parked-in-place calm idle cycle. First frame: same mascot smiling gently with both arms comfortably lowered, small dark oval eyes open. Then eyelids lower, close for a brief blink, reopen; a tiny attentive head nod and natural chest/body breathing. Last frame returns to exact first pose. Tiny 2 percent body motion only, absolutely no whole-body rotation, no hopping, no waving. Fixed feet and center. Every adjacent frame is an actual in-between eye/head/body pose, not a repeated or translated image.

recommend.action: One friendly helpful recommendation gesture, continuous in-betweens. Start front three-quarter smiling with arms at rest; raise the camera-right arm, extend it toward the right as though indicating a nearby station, briefly nod with encouraging smile, lower the arm and return to relaxed front pose. Each frame advances one evenly spaced phase; preserve the body shape and leg positions. No objects, no text, no detached symbols.

small.action: One gentle friendly hand-wave, distinct from recommendation. Full body in place. Relaxed front pose, lift the camera-left hand, wave it through two short arcs with wrist/arm articulation and a soft head tilt, lower the hand, end smiling with relaxed arms. Show actual sequential arm/hand/eyelid in-betweens. Feet stay fixed, body bounce no more than 3 percent. No whole-image tilt, no motion marks.

full.action: A cute one-shot full-refuel celebration with clear continuous key poses: 1 front smiling at rest; 2 both hands lift toward cheeks; 3 both palms gently rub pink cheeks with delighted squint; 4 body begins turning toward camera-right showing three-quarter rear; 5 rounded back/bottom faces viewer leaning slightly left; 6 bottom sways slightly right; 7 turns back toward camera with happy face; 8 settles into original relaxed front pose. Preserve the head tuft and body proportions during turning. Exactly one character per frame, no extra limbs or detached sparkles. Body turns and articulated limbs, never merely rotate the whole illustration.

recovery.action: One-shot relieved energy-recovery animation, clearly DIFFERENT from the cheerful full-refuel dance. Frame progression: 1 same mascot slightly slumped with lowered arms and tired half-closed eyes; 2 cheeks puff as it takes a breath; 3 chest lifts, hands rest on belly; 4 eyes brighten and warm smile returns; 5 stretches both arms overhead; 6 arms open wide with relieved happy face; 7 hands lower with a little relaxed exhale; 8 settles into calm smiling front pose. Continuous anatomically coherent in-betweens, grounded feet, no body turning and no butt wiggle in this state. No props, food, text or detached marks.
